name: Hedef Sanal POS
author: hedefhosting1

sections.description:
Hedef Sanal POS lets WooCommerce stores manage multiple Turkish bank virtual POS integrations from a single dashboard.
It supports installment tables, commission calculations, smart routing, and saved card workflows.

Türkçe açıklama:
Hedef Sanal POS, WooCommerce mağazaları için birden fazla banka sanal POS entegrasyonunu tek panelden yönetmenizi sağlar.
Taksit tablosu, komisyon hesaplama, otomatik yönlendirme ve kayıtlı kart gibi özellikleri destekler.

External services

This plugin connects to external payment APIs to process transactions with participating banks (Akbank, Garanti BBVA, İş Bankası, QNB, Ziraat) and PayTR. These services are required to authorize payments, refunds, voids, and 3D Secure flows. Data sent may include order totals, currency, customer billing/shipping details, card details entered at checkout, and transaction identifiers, and is sent when a payment, refund, or 3D Secure callback is initiated.

  • Akbank: https://www.akbank.com (Terms: https://www.akbank.com/en/terms-and-conditions, Privacy: https://www.akbank.com/en/privacy-policy)
  • Garanti BBVA: https://www.garantibbva.com.tr (Terms: https://www.garantibbva.com.tr/en/terms-and-conditions, Privacy: https://www.garantibbva.com.tr/en/privacy-notice)
  • İş Bankası: https://www.isbank.com.tr (Terms: https://www.isbank.com.tr/en/terms-and-conditions, Privacy: https://www.isbank.com.tr/en/privacy-policy)
  • QNB: https://www.qnb.com.tr (Terms: https://www.qnb.com.tr/en/terms-and-conditions, Privacy: https://www.qnb.com.tr/en/privacy-policy)
  • ZiraatPay API endpoints used by the plugin: https://test.ziraatpay.com.tr/ziraatpay/api/v2 and https://vpos.ziraatpay.com.tr/ziraatpay/api/v2 (Provider: Ziraat Bankası, website: https://www.ziraatbank.com.tr, Terms: https://www.ziraatbank.com.tr/en/terms-and-conditions, Privacy: https://www.ziraatbank.com.tr/en/privacy-policy)
  • PayTR: https://www.paytr.com (Terms: https://www.paytr.com/en/terms, Privacy: https://www.paytr.com/en/privacy)

The plugin can also fetch exchange rates from the Central Bank of the Republic of Türkiye (TCMB) to convert currency amounts when currency conversion is enabled. It sends no personal data; only a request to retrieve the daily XML rates at https://www.tcmb.gov.tr/kurlar/today.xml. (Privacy: https://www.tcmb.gov.tr/wps/wcm/connect/en/tcmb+en/main+page+footer/privacy+policy)
sections.installation:
1. Eklentiyi wp-content/plugins/ klasörüne yükleyin.
  2. WordPress yönetim panelinde Eklentiler menüsünden etkinleştirin.
  3. WooCommerce > Ayarlar > Ödemeler sekmesinde Hedef Sanal POS geçidini aktif edin.
  4. Hedef Sanal POS menüsünden bankalarınızı ve yönlendirme kurallarınızı yapılandırın.
sections.faq:
Hangi bankaları destekliyor?

Akbank, Garanti BBVA, İş Bankası, QNB, Ziraat ve PayTR gibi sağlayıcılar desteklenir.

Test modunu nasıl açabilirim?

WooCommerce ödeme geçidi ayarlarından test modunu etkinleştirip örnek kartlarla işlem yapabilirsiniz.
